entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Édouard Napoléon François Delamare-Deboutteville was a French inventor, engineer, and industrialist. He is known for designing and operating one of the earliest automobiles powered by a petrol-fuelled four-stroke internal combustion engine, predating the Benz Patent-Motorwagen by nearly two years.
